_about: Public-domain John Henry Hobart (1775-1830), Bishop of New York and the leader of the American high-church party, for the Word Hoard: A Companion for the Altar (1804), A Companion for the Festivals and Fasts (1804, his adaptation of Robert Nelson), An Apology for Apostolic Order (1807), Sermons on the Principal Events and Truths of Redemption (1824), his Posthumous Works with a memoir (1832, three volumes), The Christian's Manual (1844), The State of the Departed (1846) and his Correspondence (1911-1912, six volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hobart-companion-altar-1804: A companion for the altar : consisting of a short explanation of the Lord's supper, and meditations and prayers, proper to be used before, and during, the receiving of the Holy Communion, according to the form presrcibed by the Protestant Episcopal church, in the United States of America (New York : Printed for Peter A. Mesier, 1804)
hobart-festivals-fasts-1804: A companion for the festivals and fasts of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the United States of America : principally selected and altered from Nelson's companion for the festivals and fasts of the Church of England (New-York : Printed and sold by T. & J. Swords, 1804)
hobart-apology-apostolic-order-1807: An apology for apostolic order and its advocates : occasioned by the strictures and denunciations of the Christian's Magazine, in a series of letters addressed to the Rev. John M. Mason (New York : T. and J. Swords, 1807)
hobart-redemption-sermons-1824: Sermons on the principal events and truths of redemption : to which are annexed, an address and dissertation on the state of the departed, and the descent of Christ into hell, vol. 1 (London : Printed for C. and J. Rivington, 1824)
hobart-posthumous-1: The posthumous works of the late Right Reverend John Henry Hobart ... : with a memoir of his life, vol. 1 (New York : Swords, Stanford, 1832)
hobart-posthumous-2: The posthumous works of the late Right Reverend John Henry Hobart ... : with a memoir of his life, vol. 2 (New York : Swords, Stanford, 1832)
hobart-posthumous-3: The posthumous works of the late Right Reverend John Henry Hobart ... : with a memoir of his life, vol. 3 (New York : Swords, Stanford, 1832)
hobart-christians-manual-1844: The Christian's manual of faith and devotion : containing dialogues and prayers suited to the various exercises of the Christian life, and an exhortation to ejaculatory prayer, with forms of ejaculatory and other prayers (New York : Stanford and Swords, 1844)
hobart-state-of-departed-1846: The State of the departed (New York : Stanford and Swords, 1846)
hobart-correspondence-1: The correspondence of John Henry Hobart, vol. 1 (New York, Priv. print, 1911)
hobart-correspondence-2: The correspondence of John Henry Hobart, vol. 2 (New York, Priv. print, 1911)
